skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will have a fundamental understanding of science and technology, their interrelationships with economic and social development, and the ability to explain, analyze, and evaluate these relationships.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Government Policies on Science & Technology
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze government policies on science and technology, including their objectives, roles, principles, and tools, and evaluate their impact at macro levels.
Students will learn how to identify common errors in policy analysis and apply analytical processes to improve policy formulation and evaluation.
Students will understand the factors influencing R&D activities within organizations and be able to assess the strengths and weaknesses of current R&D policies in Vietnam.
Students will develop skills to evaluate science and technology policies under various scenarios and use appropriate tools for policy analysis.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Policy Formulation, Implementation, and Evaluation Skills
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to formulate, implement, and evaluate R&D policies effectively.
Students will demonstrate strong presentation skills, including logical structuring and effective communication.
Students will exhibit teamwork and group management skills, showing leadership and collaboration abilities.
Students will be capable of independently conducting operational analyses and evaluations of science and technology policies and R&D policies.
Students will show a commitment to continuous improvement, creativity, and adaptability to changes.
Students will demonstrate professional ethics and a sense of social responsibility in their work.
